color.note: Ten brand colors as the guide lists them, then the screen layer, then the election-data colors the 2026 site shipped. The brand colors never change by theme.

tokens.name: primary-black
tokens.usage: Primary color. Pantone Black C · C0 M0 Y0 K100 · R35 G31 B32. The brand's ink and its dark ground: body text on white (16.3:1) and on secondary-7506 (11.8:1); the ground behind the white logo. Mapped to ink (light) and surface (dark). From the brand guide.

tokens.name: primary-7595
tokens.usage: Primary color. Pantone 7595 C · C39 M72 Y72 K38. The brand's one accent: links, primary actions, emphasis. Text on white 8.1:1, on secondary-7506 5.9:1; white text on it 8.1:1. Fails on dark grounds (2.0:1), so the dark theme's accent is a lighter tint. The guide prints its RGB as R80 G110 B141, a misprint (that is a blue); the hex, CMYK and swatch agree on this value. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: secondary-7504
tokens.usage: Secondary color. Pantone 7504 C · C37 M50 Y69 K13 · R152 G118 B86. Supporting fills, illustration, rules. As text only at 24px+ or bold 19px+ (4.2:1 on white); primary-black on it 3.9:1, large text only. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: secondary-7506
tokens.usage: Secondary color. Pantone 7506 C · C8 M12 Y22 K0 · R232 G217 B196. The warm light ground: panels, callouts, table headers (surface-alt in light), and the dark theme's ink. Never text on white (1.4:1). From the brand guide.

tokens.name: secondary-7536
tokens.usage: Secondary color. Pantone 7536 C · C40 M36 Y47 K3 · R156 G149 B132. Hairlines and dividers on white (line in light); muted text only on dark grounds (5.5:1 on primary-black). No text on white (3.0:1). From the brand guide.

tokens.name: partisan-194
tokens.usage: Partisan color: Republican. Pantone 194 C · C29 M93 Y64 K21 · R153 G46 B69. Data encoding only. In UI use the republican token, which swaps to a legible tint in dark. 7.4:1 on white. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: partisan-5405
tokens.usage: Partisan color: Democratic. Pantone 5405 · C78 M49 Y31 K7 · R68 G113 B140. Data encoding only. In UI use the democratic token. 5.3:1 on white; 3.8:1 on secondary-7506, so text there uses democratic-ink. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bipartisan-437
tokens.usage: Bipartisan color, lightest step. Pantone 437 · C55 M64 Y39 K14 · R119 G95 B114. Data that belongs to both parties rather than one; the default single bipartisan color (the bipartisan token). 5.7:1 on white; 4.1:1 on secondary-7506, so text there uses bipartisan-ink. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bipartisan-7449
tokens.usage: Bipartisan color, middle step. Pantone 7449 U · C64 M70 Y49 K38 · R80 G64 B77. Second step of a bipartisan scale. 9.6:1 on white; too close to dark grounds (1.7:1) to use there. From the brand guide.

tokens.name: bipartisan-439
tokens.usage: Bipartisan color, darkest step. Pantone 439 C · C67 M72 Y54 K54 · R59 G47 B57. Third step of a bipartisan scale. 12.7:1 on white; not on dark grounds (1.3:1). From the brand guide.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. White in light, as the guide's pages are; Black C in dark, the ground the guide puts the white logo on.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Secondary ground: panels, callouts, table header rows, sidebars. Cream 7506 C in light; in dark a lifted Black C, a screen-only value, not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverted bands: a header or footer strip, a full-bleed hero. Black C in light, cream in dark. Put ink-inverse on it, and the white logo in light.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: A barely warm ground for hover rows, card hover and small header strips. Ink on it 14.6:1 and ink-muted 6.2:1 in light; in dark it equals surface-alt. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on surface and surface-alt: 16.3:1 and 11.8:1 in light; 11.8:1 and 10.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions, on surface and surface-alt: 6.9:1 and 5.0:1 in light (a darkened 7536 C, a screen-only value, not a guide swatch); 7536 C itself in dark, 5.5:1 and 4.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse: white on Black C (16.3:1) in light, Black C on cream (11.8:1) in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers between rows and sections. Carries no meaning on its own, so it sits under 3:1 by design.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, checkboxes, table outlines. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-alt in both themes. The light value is a screen-only value, not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Card and table borders that only group things (1.7:1 on surface in light). Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: The lightest dividers, between rows inside a card. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary actions, links, selected states: 7595 C in light (8.1:1 on surface, 5.9:1 on surface-alt). In dark a lighter 7595 C tint, 5.8:1 on surface and 5.1:1 on surface-alt (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch). Never for party data.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill: white in light (8.1:1), Black C in dark (5.8:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, always underlined: ink in light (16.3:1 on surface), cream in dark (11.8:1). The underline is what marks a link, since the color matches body text. Changed from the 7595 accent, which read as muddy and too red for links (Ross, 10/27).

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover: 7595 in light (8.1:1 on surface, 5.9:1 on surface-alt), white in dark (16.3:1).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring color: solid, 2px, outside a 2px gap of surface (see the focus-ring shadow). At least 5:1 against surface and surface-alt in both themes.

tokens.name: republican
tokens.usage: Republican in charts, maps, tags and results. 194 C in light (7.4:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on surface-alt). In dark a lighter 194 C tint, 5.8:1 and 5.1:1 (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch). Always pair with a word or letter (R, Republican).

tokens.name: on-republican
tokens.usage: Text on a republican fill: white in light (7.4:1), Black C in dark (5.8:1).

tokens.name: democratic
tokens.usage: Democratic in charts, maps, tags and results. 5405 in light (5.3:1 on surface; 3.8:1 on surface-alt, so fills, map areas and chart marks only there; text there uses democratic-ink). In dark a lighter 5405 tint, 5.8:1 and 5.1:1 (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch). Always pair with a word or letter (D, Democratic).

tokens.name: on-democratic
tokens.usage: Text on a democratic fill: white in light (5.3:1), Black C in dark (5.8:1).

tokens.name: democratic-ink
tokens.usage: Democratic-colored text (party names, figures, labels) on surface-alt. In light a darkened 5405, same hue: 4.5:1 on surface-alt and 6.3:1 on surface (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch). In dark it follows democratic (5.8:1 and 5.1:1). Keep democratic itself for fills, map areas and chart marks.

tokens.name: bipartisan
tokens.usage: Bipartisan data as one color: 437 in light (5.7:1 on surface; 4.1:1 on surface-alt, so fills and marks only there; text there uses bipartisan-ink). In dark a lighter 437 tint, 5.8:1 and 5.1:1 (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch).

tokens.name: on-bipartisan
tokens.usage: Text on a bipartisan fill: white in light (5.7:1), Black C in dark (5.8:1).

tokens.name: independent
tokens.usage: Independent candidates: the I chip's fill, always with its I label. White text on it 6.9:1 in light; Black C on it 5.5:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: party-other
tokens.usage: Any other party (Libertarian, Green, …), shown by name in a neutral gray chip: never a party color and never Independent's. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: on-party-other
tokens.usage: Text on party-other: 10.7:1 in light, 8.1:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: party-other-bar
tokens.usage: Another party's result bar. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: bar-track
tokens.usage: The empty track behind result bars. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: footer
tokens.usage: The site footer band. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: footer-ink
tokens.usage: Text on footer: 11.8:1 in light, 12.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: footer-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on footer: 5.5:1 in light, 6.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Change highlights and the notification dot only: a 2px line with a soft halo on whatever just changed, or a tint behind a new news update. It's RSI's orange (the arrow in the RSI logo), never text: 2.1:1 on white. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: highlight-tint
tokens.usage: The background behind a news update nobody has seen yet, with 2px highlight lines above and below. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: bipartisan-ink
tokens.usage: Bipartisan-colored text on surface-alt. In light a darkened 437, same hue: 4.5:1 on surface-alt and 6.3:1 on surface (a screen-only value, not a guide swatch). In dark it follows bipartisan (5.8:1 and 5.1:1). Keep bipartisan itself for fills and marks.

tokens.name: map-won-d
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race won by a Democrat (the winner's party, not RWP's outcome). Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-won-r
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race won by a Republican. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-won-i
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race won by an Independent, or by a candidate with no party: the bipartisan purple. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-won-o
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race won by any other party: neutral gray, cooler than map-tbd (Ross, 11/01). Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-lean-d
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race leaning Democratic. Won and leaning differ mostly in lightness: 2.8:1 from map-won-d in light, 1.5:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-lean-r
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race leaning Republican: 3.3:1 from map-won-r in light, 1.8:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-lean-i
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race leaning Independent or no party. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-lean-o
tokens.usage: Map fill. A race leaning to any other party. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-tbd
tokens.usage: Map fill. A tracked race still TBD. Only 1.3:1 from map-none in light (2.1:1 in dark), so the legend and hover carry the difference. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-none
tokens.usage: Map fill. States and districts with no race RWP tracks. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-stroke
tokens.usage: Borders between states and districts. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: State and district labels, drawn over a map-halo stroke so they read on any fill. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-halo
tokens.usage: The stroke behind map labels and around outcome icons. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: map-dim-stroke
tokens.usage: Borders of states outside the current view. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: region-1
tokens.usage: "Our Regions" map view: sand, Rural West. Regions are told apart by hue only (about 1.0–1.2:1 from one another), so the view always shows its legend. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: region-2
tokens.usage: "Our Regions" map view: sage, American South. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: region-3
tokens.usage: "Our Regions" map view: mauve, Appalachia / Ozarks. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: region-4
tokens.usage: "Our Regions" map view: a fourth region, unused in 2026. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-win-bg
tokens.usage: Win badge fill. A green, outside the brand guide by design (Q34). Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-win-fg
tokens.usage: Win badge text: 7.5:1 in light, 7.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: b-win-bd
tokens.usage: Win badge border.

tokens.name: b-lw-bg
tokens.usage: Leaning win badge fill; its border is dashed. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-lw-fg
tokens.usage: Leaning win badge text: 6.4:1 in light, 7.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: b-lw-bd
tokens.usage: Leaning win badge dashed border.

tokens.name: b-tbd-bg
tokens.usage: TBD badge fill. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-tbd-fg
tokens.usage: TBD badge text: 5.8:1 in light, 5.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: b-tbd-bd
tokens.usage: TBD badge border.

tokens.name: b-ll-bg
tokens.usage: Leaning loss badge fill; its border is dashed. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-ll-fg
tokens.usage: Leaning loss badge text: 6.1:1 in light, 7.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: b-ll-bd
tokens.usage: Leaning loss badge dashed border.

tokens.name: b-loss-bg
tokens.usage: Loss badge fill: a brown, not the 7595 accent. Differs from the Win fill by 3.2:1 in light and 4.0:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: b-loss-fg
tokens.usage: Loss badge text: 7.0:1 in light, 6.5:1 in dark.

tokens.name: b-loss-bd
tokens.usage: Loss badge border.

tokens.name: i-win
tokens.usage: Map outcome icon, Win: a green scalloped rosette with a check. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: i-win-soft
tokens.usage: Map outcome icon, Leaning win: the light disc behind a green check, with a dashed ring. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: i-loss
tokens.usage: Map outcome icon, Loss: a smaller muted warm-gray disc with a cross. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: i-loss-soft
tokens.usage: Map outcome icon, Leaning loss: the light disc behind a gray cross, with a dashed ring. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

tokens.name: i-mark
tokens.usage: The check or cross drawn on a filled outcome icon: 7.5:1 on i-win in light, 8.0:1 in dark. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Oswald in the guide's three weights: Heavy 900, Bold 700, Semibold 600. The sizes are a starter scale, not from the guide.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Oswald Heavy. One per page at most: hero and cover headlines.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Oswald Semibold. Card titles, subsection heads, chart titles.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Lato in the guide's five weights: Semibold 600, Medium 500, Regular 400, Light 300, Thin 200. No Bold: Semibold is the emphasis weight. Sizes are a starter scale, not from the guide.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: An intro paragraph set in Lato Light.
styles.usage: Lato Light. The first paragraph under a page title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy is set in Lato Regular at sixteen pixels.
styles.usage: Lato Regular. Running text; emphasis in Lato Semibold, not Bold.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Lato Medium for table cells and metadata
styles.usage: Lato Medium. Table cells, captions, metadata, form help.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Lato Semibold, set in capitals with wide tracking like the logo's PROJECT line. Eyebrows above headlines, table column headers, tags.

styles.name: thin
styles.usage: Lato Thin. Large figures only, 32px and up, in ink on surface or surface-alt. Never for body text.

spacing.note: A 4px starter scale for screens. Not from the guide.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; between a party letter and its number.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and compact controls; between stacked labels and values.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding; between related rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; the default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Around hero blocks and inverse bands.

radius.note: Crisp corners after the primary logo's lightly eased hexagon; full rounds only for circles, after the badge. Not from the guide.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inputs, checkboxes, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, panels, menus.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Circles only: the badge shape, avatars, legend dots.

shadow.note: The brand is flat: the focus ring and the change highlight are its only shadows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap in the surface color, then 2px of solid focus. Box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

tokens.name: glow
tokens.usage: The change highlight on a badge or card: 2px of highlight with a halo, held until seen, then faded over about 4 seconds. Shipped on the 2026 election site; not a guide swatch.
